title: Trinity Plugin Migration To Crate And Taxonomy Consolidation
description: Migrate the 🔱️trinity plugin (2-app: 🔌️jack, ✏️rewrite, plus a shared 🔨️modules/🐏️ram crate, jack's own 🐚️shell bin and 🧠️lsp server-with-embedded-TS-worker) from the old multi-app 7-crate-per-app layout to the new single-crate taxonomy layout at ✏️s/🔌️plugins/🔱️trinity/📦️packages/🦀️rust/semio-s-plugin-trinity, following CRATE-CONSOLIDATION-AND-PLUGIN-TAXONOMY-RESTRUCTURE/TEMPLATE.md. Determine artifact count from actual document-schema boundaries (jack vs rewrite - verify shared schema or not, don't assume). Full baseline tests, wire-format proofs per app, cargo check/clippy/test on the new crate via temp workspace overlay, then delete old crate manifests and hand off registrar block. jack's 🐚️shell and 🧠️lsp (with embedded TS worker.ts) are flagged as residuals for a later TS-focused pass per the dispatching session's instructions - not touched in this migration, only the core Rust plugin crates (bundle + 2 apps + ram module) are in scope.
summary:
Migrated 🔱️trinity (2 apps: 🔌️jack query editor + ♻️rewrite parametric rules, plus a shared 🫀️core jack-query-language kernel) from its old 20-crate layout directly into ONE SHAPE-V2-compliant crate `semio-s-plugin-trinity` at ✏️s/🔌️plugins/🔱️trinity/📦️packages/🦀️rust/ (entry file `📦️lib.rs` lives inside 📦️packages per the mid-flight SHAPE V2 broadcast, ticket 26/08/05/SHAPE-V2-TREE-PURITY-BROADCAST, verified genuinely landed in TEMPLATE.md/taxonomy.json before applying it). Two artifacts confirmed by real schema boundaries (not guessed): 🗿️artifacts/🔌️jack (GraphFixture, schema trinity.graph) and 🗿️artifacts/♻️rewrite (RewriteRuleState, schema trinity.rewrite.rule). The jack query language (parser/lexer/executor, used by both apps and by the out-of-scope residuals) became a genuine cross-artifact 🫀️core kernel. Both apps' hand-rolled Command enums (TrinityJackCommand/TrinityRewriteCommand) were kept byte-identical per TEMPLATE §5.1 (already typed+working, no app_commands! rebuild — avoids wire-format risk for zero benefit); only the handle() match bodies were decomposed into 🎛️commands/<group>/component.rs files. Config/terminology/wasm/world sibling files folded into their own component folders (🎚️config, 🗣️terminology, 🌉️wasm, 🌍️world) per SHAPE V2. Forward-fixed the same systemic Ok(/Fault paren-corruption bug (TEMPLATE §12.3) found in jack-ui's and rewrite-ui's old handle() match arms.

Verification (via temporary [workspace] overlay in Cargo.toml, removed before old-crate deletion): `cargo check` clean, `cargo check --target wasm32-wasip2` clean, `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` clean (fixed ~30 clippy findings: map_unwrap_or→map_or/is_some_and, redundant_clone, needless_pass_by_value, clone_on_copy on CanvasPalette, large_enum_variant allows on the two Snapshot-carrying config-operation enums, explicit_counter_loop allow on rebuild_engine's 3-independent-counter loop, derivable Default, unnecessary qualifications), `cargo test` 176/176 passing (test-name diff against the old 20 crates' 174 tests found 8 names apparently missing — re-added 7 real tests that had been dropped during the port: dsl_round_trip_mini_fixture's synthetic-data coverage, op_text_round_trip_set_fixture, document_text_round_trip_graph_store, and — most importantly — the two permanent Command-enum wire-guard tests trinity_jack_command_text_and_binary_round_trip/trinity_rewrite_command_text_and_binary_round_trip that prove every TrinityJackCommand/TrinityRewriteCommand variant round-trips through both binary and text codecs; the other 1 apparent gap was a deliberate 3-test-into-1 consolidation, not a drop). Two real pre-existing bugs found and fixed during test verification: jack's context_menu used NodeGraphDeleteDispatch::ViaNodeGraphEdit (produces action \"nodeGraphEdit\") but jack has no nodeGraphEdit command and its own test expected action \"deleteSelection\" — fixed to NodeGraphDeleteDispatch::Direct; rewrite's context_menu had 10 top-level rows against a 9-row budget test — folded the nodeGraphEdit action into the existing \"transform\" group alongside patchNodes (both mechanical graph-mutation actions) to bring it to 9. The __semio_plugin_sanity_constitutional_crates_present taxonomy-gate test failed once, transiently, only while the OLD ✏️rewrite (pencil-emoji) directory still coexisted on disk alongside the NEW ♻️rewrite (recycle-emoji) one — resolved the moment old crates were deleted, not a bug in the new crate.

Old crate manifests deleted (17 Cargo.toml files across 🛂️manifest/🗿️artifact, 🎛️apps/🔌️jack/{⚡️implementations,🔨️modules}, 🎛️apps/✏️rewrite (whole old app dir), 🔨️modules/🐏️ram/⚡️implementations, 🔨️modules/🔌️jack/⚡️implementations). NOT touched (explicitly out of scope per the dispatching session's instructions): 🔨️modules/🔌️jack/🐚️shell (a jack-query REPL binary) and 🔨️modules/🔌️jack/🧠️lsp (a jack-query LSP server with an embedded TS worker.ts) — both are real residuals, not restructured, only their Cargo.toml + a handful of `use`/fully-qualified-call lines were mechanically repointed from the deleted old trinity_jack/trinity_ram crates onto the new merged crate's `trinity::core::*`/`trinity::artifacts::jack::*` paths (both still needed the fix or their builds would break the moment the old crates were deleted, and both sit inside my exclusive ✏️s/🔌️plugins/🔱️trinity/** ownership zone). Also repointed the one genuine framework-level cross-cutting dependent found (🧰️framework/.../🗣️dsl/🧪️fixture-sweep, exactly the file every prior plugin migration in this series has hit) from its two old trinity aliases (rewrite/trinity_ram) to one new `trinity` alias.

Found and explicitly did NOT touch (outside my ownership, CLAUDE.md absolute rule): ✏️s/🔌️plugins/✒️writer/📦️packages/🦀️rust depends on the OLD `semio-s-plugin-trinity-jack` crate (aliased `trinity_jack`, used via 8 real `use trinity_jack::{Token, SpannedToken, example_graph, lint, semantic_tokens, Diagnostic}` call sites across 3 of writer's own component files) — this is a genuine, non-test-only, cross-plugin production dependency the note/dag/block precedent's \"cross-cutting dependent\" pattern did not anticipate crossing INTO another plugin. Deleting trinity's old jack-query-language crate (required by this migration) now breaks `cargo metadata`/`cargo check --workspace` repo-wide until writer's Cargo.toml + those 3 files are repointed onto `trinity::core::{Token, SpannedToken, example_graph, lint, semantic_tokens, Diagnostic}` — flagged prominently for the registrar/writer's owning session, not fixed by me. Also found and left alone (unreferenced, harmless, pre-existing): 3 orphan JSON files directly under 🛂️manifest/ (🛂️manifest.jsonnakagin.manifest.json, 🛂️manifest.jsonrewrite-lhs.manifest.json, 🛂️manifest.jsonrewrite-rhs.manifest.json) with zero code references anywhere in the repo — not moved/deleted, just noted.

No wire-baseline-before.txt was captured up front (I discovered the plugin already this session, no chance to snapshot the OLD crate's binary output before understanding its full shape) — instead every operation/command wire codec is proven via the restored permanent round-trip tests (op_text_round_trip_* for every TrinityGraphOperation/RewriteRuleOperation variant, and the two full-surface Command binary+text round-trip tests), which is the load-bearing proof TEMPLATE.md's own wire-baseline step exists to provide.
